videos.notes: The original description labels 40 recommendation chapters after excluding Intro, the Tripo3D sponsor segment, and The Full Modpack outro. Two recommendation chapters are multi-project bundles: Farmer's Delight's addons expands to four creator-linked child projects at 10:37, and Break free + Multi mine expands to two child projects at 18:40. Therefore 40 chapters preserve 44 project recommendation mentions.
